# Yashh Techstudio

> AI agent development studio run by Yashh Sharma (Ghaziabad, India — works remotely with clients worldwide). Builds custom AI agents, small SaaS products with agents built in, and the websites around them.

## Services and starting prices
- Custom AI agents — from $800 setup + $100/month support (India: from ₹40,000). Sales/lead follow-up agents, customer support agents that answer from your own docs, developer agents (code review, tests, bug triage), research agents, ops & reporting agents, finance (invoice follow-up) agents, content agents, hiring/screening agents, WhatsApp and website chat assistants that take bookings. Every agent ships with guardrails, logs and human approval for important actions.
- SaaS & web app MVPs with AI features — from $2,500 (India: from ₹1,50,000). Next.js, auth, database, payments, agents on Claude or OpenAI.
- Websites & landing pages — landing page from $300, business website from $800, redesign from $500 (India: ₹15,000 / ₹35,000 / ₹25,000).

## Proof of work
- Runs its own 3-agent outreach system in production: Lead Hunter (finds and audits businesses, sends personalised emails with safety checks), X Scout (finds people asking for help on X, drafts replies for human approval), Inbox Manager (handles replies and follow-ups, writes a daily report).
- Relay — a concept SaaS CRM with three AI agents built in (follow-up, lead scoring, meeting booking), an approvals queue and an "Ask Relay" chat over the pipeline. Live demo: https://relay-vert-eight.vercel.app
- Aria Cole — a concept portfolio for a motion designer: kinetic-type hero, looping CSS/SVG motion reels and an inquiry form. Creator & personal portfolios start at $500. Live demo: https://aria-motion.vercel.app
- Front-end concept sites: NOIR (café), NOVA Estates (real estate), Orbit AI (SaaS launch page), RYŌIKI (animated fan site).

## Founder
Yashh Sharma — AI orchestration engineer (multi-agent systems with Paperclip, Claude Code, MCP) with 3+ years of frontend engineering and product design (Next.js, React, TypeScript, React Native).
